<section id="storage-and-configuration">
<h1>Storage and configuration</h1>
<section id="default-layout">
<h2>Default layout</h2>
<p>A normal project stores release state inside the workspace:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">config_version</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span>
<span class="n">releaseledger_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.releaseledger&quot;</span>

<span class="n">ledger_ref</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;main&quot;</span>
<span class="n">ledger_parent_ref</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="n">ledger_next_entry_number</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span>
<span class="n">ledger_branch_guard</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;off&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[ledger]</span>
<span class="n">code</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;rl&quot;</span>
<span class="n">name</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;releaseledger&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[release]</span>
<span class="n">default_changelog</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;CHANGELOG.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">default_status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;planned&quot;</span>
<span class="n">allow_dirty_worktree</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Storage tree:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>.releaseledger/
  ledgers/
    main/
      releases/
        &lt;version&gt;/
          release.md
          entries/
            entry-0001.md
      events/
        events.jsonl
      indexes/
        releases.json
        entries.json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Release and entry Markdown records use schema version 2 and include validated
record metadata:</p>
<div class="highlight-yaml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nt">schema_version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">2</span>
<span class="nt">object_type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">release</span>
<span class="nt">versioning</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">schema_version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">1</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">revision</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">1</span>
<span class="nt">version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">1.2.0</span>
<span class="nt">status</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">released</span>
<span class="nt">released_at</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">2026-06-14</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released_at</span></code> is the public changelog date. Mutation dates are not stored.
Indexes are derived and expose <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">record_revision</span></code> for inspection. Events are
append-only operation rows with affected record revisions; git history provides
chronology and exact before/after content.</p>
</section>
<section id="external-state-directories">
<h2>External state directories</h2>
<p>Projects that keep generated state in a sibling repository can opt in to an
external path:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">releaseledger_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;../ledger/release/releaseledger&quot;</span>
<span class="n">releaseledger_dir_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;external&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The CLI form is:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--releaseledger-dir<span class="w"> </span>../ledger/release/releaseledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--external-dir

releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="w"> </span>releaseledger_dir<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>../ledger/release/releaseledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--external-dir
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Relative paths that escape the workspace are rejected unless the external
policy is explicit.</p>
</section>
<section id="diagnostics">
<h2>Diagnostics</h2>
<p>Inspect effective paths and layout health without mutating state:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>storage<span class="w"> </span>where
releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>storage<span class="w"> </span>where
releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>show
releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>show
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
